program_cost_usd.stat: tuition for the whole 60-credit program, non-resident and international students, at the current fee schedule; residents of Oregon, Washington and other western states 43,560; full-time fees 4,503, for 58,383 in all; the page names no academic year
program_cost_usd.src: Portland State MBA tuition and fees page

salary_median_usd.stat: median salary (average 89067), classes of 2021 and 2022 combined; 27% of graduates reported salary; page notes data not collected per MBACSEA standards

employment_rate_pct.stat: 95% of the classes of 2021 and 2022 who were seeking jobs were employed after finishing the MBA; no timeframe defined; not MBACSEA standard

notes: Class profile page publishes no GMAT, GRE, acceptance rate, or class size. Daytime cohort figures used as the full-time program; Evening figures noted in stat. Tuition year omitted because the page does not state the academic year. Portland, OR address confirmed in page footer. US News rank not included: could not fetch a usnews.com page (blocked). The name joins the two parts the school's own header prints together, "Portland State University" and "The School of Business"; its site title reads "The School of Business at PSU" (https://www.pdx.edu/business/, read 2026-09-27).
